description: Manage which Grafana users can access which DevLake projects on dashboards.

options.content:
## User Project Access
Select a **User Login** and **Project** from the dropdowns above, then click Add or Remove below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT user_login AS 'User Login', project_name AS 'Project' FROM user_project_mapping ORDER BY user_login, project_name

list.label: User Login
list.name: userLogin
list.description: Grafana username to grant or revoke project access for

list.definition: SELECT name FROM projects ORDER BY name
list.label: Project
list.name: project
list.query: SELECT name FROM projects ORDER BY name
list.description: DevLake project to grant or revoke

title: Admin: User Project Access
